is alkene, it decolourises bromine water.

2. The major component of natural gas is meth-
ane, which, on pyrolysis, gives hydrogen gas.
The hydrogen so obtained can be used in the
synthesis of ammonia which is the most impor-
tant component of nitrogenous fertilizers.
Hence, the correct option is (a).

4. Ethane + water $\rightarrow$ Ethyl alcohol $\Rightarrow$ Addition of
water
$\text{Ethene} \xrightarrow{\frac{\mathrm{O}_3, \mathrm{Zn}}{\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}}} \text{Formaldehyde}$
$\quad \Rightarrow \text{Ozonolysis}$

$\text{Ethene} \xrightarrow{[\mathrm{O].}\mathrm{KMNO}_4} \text{Ethylene glycol}$
$\quad \Rightarrow \text{Oxidation}$

$\text{Ethene} + \mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow \mathrm{CO}_2 + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \text{Combustion}$
Hence, the correct option is (c).

Hence, the correct option is (d).

6. GMM = 2 × 36 = 72
X may be alkane/alkene/alkyne
If X is alkane; $\mathrm{C}_n \mathrm{H}_{2n} +_2, n = 1, 2, 3, 4...$
$\therefore \mathrm{GMM} = 12n + 2n + 2 = 72$
$\Rightarrow 14n = 70$
$\Rightarrow n = 5$
$\therefore \mathrm{X}$ is $\mathrm{C}_5 \mathrm{H}_{12}$.

8. $\mathrm{C}_4\mathrm{H}_8$ is cyclobutane (or) butene.
$\mathrm{C}_5\mathrm{H}_8$ is pentyne.
$\mathrm{C}_6\mathrm{H}_{14}$ is hexane.
$\mathrm{C}_7\mathrm{H}_{16}$ is heptane.
Hence, the correct option is (a).

9. $\mathrm{CaC}_2 + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_2 + \mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{OH})_2$

Ethyne

$\therefore$ Number of moles of $\mathrm{O}_2$ is $5/2 = 2.5$.
Hence, the correct option is (a).
